scope: Implemented native candidate and bounded diagnostics after preserved #329 prechange baseline. Default remains baseline. Functional tests do not close MW-04 hardware/release gates or parent #326.

native_framework.package: WebRTC 150.7871.01, existing pinned SwiftPM macOS framework

policy.flag_application: new capture only; independent of codec
policy.metrics_false_scope: Metric counters off; queue-policy clocks retained. Polling off is not native counters off.
policy.frame_age_basis: Native continuous clock since latest accepted callback, including suspended time; not capture timestamp latency.
policy.capture_quality_update: restart_required; geometry updates use acknowledged SCK configuration plus matching fresh frame.

checks.name: Preimplementation native boundary and processor RED
checks.observation: Frozen 2057 actual native SCK: 16 cases 4 PASS/12 FAIL; processor: 5 cases 3 PASS/2 FAIL. Reproduced missing explicit-display fallback, stale callbacks, status/PTS guards and unnecessary conversion/oversized failure. Original RED hashes are historical, not current source claims.

checks.name: boundary actual native synthetic suite
limitations: Private stream identity seam bypasses startup; does not validate permissions, actual capture, queue age, audio, performance or physical selection.

checks.name: processor actual native synthetic suite
limitations: Old generic conversion helper is a spy; real WebRTC I420 scaling and CV pool exhaustion/reuse are tested. Processing performance and total heap allocations are not measured.

checks.name: diagnostics actual native synthetic suite
limitations: Does not prove native bridge dispatch, actual capture, pipeline timing or hardware throughput.

checks.name: lifecycle actual native synthetic suite
limitations: Native stream identities/start acknowledgments and audio sink are synthetic. No permissions, OS startup, PCM decoding or physical audio/capture acceptance is proved.

checks.name: Color/aperture metadata RED to GREEN
checks.observation: P3 source labels and old aperture/display dimensions were wrongly copied onto resized sRGB output. Two focused failures became green with current RGB/geometry labels. Direct/no-resize identity retains original attachments. This does not prove physical color fidelity or HDR capability.

checks.name: Suspended virtual-clock gap RED to GREEN
checks.observation: Native queue/frame age now uses mach_continuous_time per primary SDK header. A queued sample separated by a synthetic ten-second suspended gap is dropped and its snapshot age increases correctly; actual OS sleep/wake was not performed.

checks.name: Startup failure ownership RED to GREEN
checks.observation: Actual DesktopCapturer/SCK injected enumeration failure with video and audio=false/true originally retained one stop handler and RTC source per failed start. Both now retain zero handlers and release the source. Both owned error paths remove registry ownership before FlutterError.
limitations: Factory, audio owner and FlutterError are fakes; no native permission, real factory, playback or OS capture behavior is proved.
Legacy RTC window/audio-only startup failure is not exercised by this two-case suite; its cleanup is symmetric and compilation-checked.

checks.name: Dart snapshot bridge tests
checks.observation: Pinned Flutter 3.47.5; unavailable/old plugin/malformed schema does not invent confirmation, exact track query and null fields preserved.

checks.name: LiveKit captureEngine option tests
checks.observation: Root ran pinned SDK tests after correcting the test to use concrete capture options. Source ID/FPS/audio and optional flag survive copyWith; omitted flag preserves constraints.

checks.name: Native minimum deployment availability
checks.observation: Changed capture/processor/adapter/diagnostics translation units pass clang syntax at macOS 10.15 with unguarded availability treated as error; no compiler warnings/errors. This is not a full Release app build. After startup cleanup, DesktopCapturer was rechecked with the same macOS 10.15 availability guard and produced no diagnostics.

checks.name: Actual candidate OS capture in unsigned Debug prototype
checks.observation: Preserved physical Mac own synthetic-window cases8-10 and static first-receiver case11 are recorded in issue329/332; geometry-fixed own full-display case16 is recorded in issue333. One physical publisher plus cohosted headless browser only. Exact source/build receipts remain in those records; native accepted/postprocessed counters and bridge are actually sampled. No two-device, SLO, audio or signed release PASS is inferred.

checks.name: Ad-hoc QA Release build and owned window capture flow
checks.observation: Exact f339 main with canonical vendor81b3: actual QA Release capture and cohosted headless decoder flow PASS, 30s warmup/60s steady. codesign reports ad-hoc, not production Developer ID/distribution. Original synthetic receiver reviewed by runtime agent; no blank output, system badge partially overlaps first heading. This is not signed installed/deployed acceptance, SLO, Retina/DPI, color fidelity, audio/voice or paired physical hardware proof.

checks.name: Performance, static first frame, resize/DPI, failure lifecycle and resource-return matrix
checks.observation: Local Debug window/display prototype counters and a static first-receiver case have actual receipts; the complete multi-profile resize/DPI, source-loss/permission, stop/start/resource return and Release matrix is not closed. Performance is cohosted and thresholds are unapproved. Native pool first-seen/acquisition counters do not measure total heap allocations or zero-copy performance.

checks.name: Physical playback audio and voice invariants
checks.observation: Synthetic queue-isolation spy is not PCM or physical A/V synchronization. Window-filter playback audio scope, own-process exclusion and unchanged voice need device evidence.

checks.name: Actual sleep/wake and independent two-device/remote receiver acceptance
checks.observation: User keeps this Mac awake and only this Mac is available. Virtual-clock tests cannot close actual sleep/wake; independent device/stage and parent quality gates remain open.

checks.name: Production signed installed and deployment acceptance
checks.observation: Ad-hoc QA Release signing does not establish production Developer ID/distribution signature, installed-update or deployed-client acceptance.

limitations: No causal claim that this pipeline caused the reported 18 FPS.
Synthetic exact-source records and private stream/start-ack seams do not prove actual source selection, permissions or OS startup.
No frame pixels, source titles/IDs, audio payloads or authentication data are included in this public record.
Capture timestamp latency and total heap allocations remain unknown; no HDR or hardware capacity capability is claimed.

diagnostics_sdk_switch.runtime_overhead: PASS_SCOPED_MEASUREMENT only: actual sequential same-binary OFF19/ON20, 30s warmup/60s steady. Approved overhead budget gate NOT_RUN; metadata-writer and scheduling/thermal confounds retained.

P1080_60 display may capture1920x1246; #333 publisher uses confirmed actual dimensions for existing both-axis encoder bounds. Configured geometry1662x1078 differs by one decoder height pixel1662x1079, explicitly retained.

runtime_scope_corrections.open_gates: Second physical device, physical scanout/SLO, audio/voice invariants, Retina/DPI/color matrix, actual sleep/wake and production signed installed/deployment acceptance remain open. Ad-hoc QA Release owned window flow has scoped proof.
